entities.summary: Shirley Mae Goodman was an American R&B singer, best known as one half of Shirley & Lee, a 1950s duo. Later in her career, she had a resurgence as part of the group Shirley and Company with the disco hit "Shame, Shame, Shame" in the 1970s.
